conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and concentrating on income and broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more limited upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable balance of risk and reward.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentrating in high-scoring setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing, meaning losses can accumulate very quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% monthly yield by rotating into income and broad index ETFs. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable distributions over growth, cutting leveraged and high-beta single names. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
